Card Q&A.q: If the Digimon with this card in its digivolution cards is itself red, does this card’s inherited effect activate?

Inherited Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a red Digimon in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞. (When an opponent's Digimon attacks, you may suspend this Digimon to force the opponent to attack it instead.)
